notice: These are paraphrased supporting facts recorded from primary-publisher documents and indexed primary text, not verbatim source copies or original PDF hashes. Some NCERT endpoints timed out and old SATHEE URLs redirected to an index; those redirects were not accepted as chapter evidence. Available indexed chapter text is identified explicitly. Original examination PDF hash is recorded separately.

optical-response.title: OpenStax University Physics: Polarization
optical-response.support: Polarization is defined by electric-field direction; this alone does not establish the exclusive eye-response wording of Q71, which stays held.

circuits.title: OpenStax University Physics: Resistors in Series and Parallel
circuits.support: Series resistances add; parallel reciprocal resistances add. With R=rho L/A the displayed X-Y parallel pair plus Y-Z series wire is 3R/2.

atomic.title: OpenStax Chemistry: Atomic Structure and Symbolism
atomic.support: Atomic number counts protons; mass number counts protons and neutrons. An anion has extra electrons equal to the magnitude of its negative charge.

carbon.title: NCERT Chemistry exemplar, The p-Block Elements
carbon.support: Question 19 explicitly identifies graphite as the thermodynamically most stable carbon allotrope. Ordinary reference conditions are understood, not all pressures.

mixtures.title: NCERT: Is Matter Around Us Pure, IIT Kanpur SATHEE hosted text
mixtures.retrieval: indexed NCERT chapter text; live redirect not used as evidence
mixtures.support: Colloids and suspensions are heterogeneous. Individual colloid particles are not visible to the naked eye. Centrifugation can separate colloidal particles. Copper sulphate solution is a true solution, while diluted milk remains colloidal.

separation.title: OpenStax Chemistry: Phase Transitions
separation.support: Evaporation removes liquid into vapour; solid crystallization separates solid from solution. The question asks whether these methods may be used, not whether they suit every solute.

redox.title: OpenStax Chemistry: Classifying Chemical Reactions
redox.support: Oxidation raises oxidation number; reduction lowers it. The reducing agent is oxidized and the oxidizing agent is reduced. Iron corrosion and fuel combustion are redox processes; oxidation of lipids causes oxidative rancidity.

fruit-browning.title: University of Florida IFAS: Harvesting and Postharvest Handling of Stonefruits
fruit-browning.support: Mixing phenolic substrates and enzymes after loss of cellular compartmentation leads to phenolic oxidation and fruit browning.

acids.title: OpenStax Chemistry: Bronsted-Lowry Acids and Bases
acids.support: The historical Arrhenius definition specifies aqueous hydrogen cations for acids and hydroxide anions for bases. Bronsted-Lowry generalizes to proton transfer.

superphosphate.title: Kansas State Agricultural Experiment Station: Fertilizers and their Use, SB169
superphosphate.support: Treating calcium phosphate with sulphuric acid produces monocalcium phosphate mixed with calcium sulphate, the superphosphate of commerce. Its printed equation directly distinguishes this route from hydrochloric/nitric acid or sodium hydroxide.

mass.title: OpenStax Chemistry: Early Ideas in Atomic Theory
mass.support: The law of conservation of matter requires unchanged total mass in a chemical change. Q83 balances 1.7+0.585=1.435+0.85=2.285 g, excluding unchanged solvent.

nitrolim.title: NOAA CAMEO Chemicals: Calcium cyanamide
nitrolim.support: Calcium cyanamide is the salt formed by reaction of calcium carbide and nitrogen, with Nitrolim/Nitrolime listed as names. Hydrolysis yields ammonia; balanced net equation CaCN2+3H2O -> CaCO3+2NH3 supports moist-soil conversion. Carbon produced in manufacture does not turn it into an organic fertilizer.

fertilizer-definition.title: ISO 8157 fertilizer vocabulary
fertilizer-definition.support: The inorganic-fertilizer definition specifically lists calcium cyanamide as inorganic by convention. It is a nitrogen product, not a formulated NPK fertilizer.

paint.title: Getty Conservation Institute: Modern Paints Uncovered
paint.support: The discussion of synthetic-resin emulsion paints includes pine oil among defoamers. It does not by itself resolve every printed paint-additive statement in Q85/Q86; both stay held.

lewis.title: OpenStax Chemistry: Lewis Acids and Bases
lewis.support: Electron-pair acceptors are Lewis acids; donors are bases. BF3 and AlCl3 are electron-deficient acceptors, Fe(III) accepts ligand donor pairs, and NH3 donates its lone pair.

paper-tests.title: TAPPI physical-property test standards
paper-tests.support: The standards catalogue lists surface roughness (T538/T555), internal bond and bending strength (T541/T543/T556), and resistance/air permeance (T536/T547). Thus permeability is not excluded from paper physical testing.

paper-optics.title: TAPPI Paper Properties and Testing
paper-optics.support: The association's own course includes physical tests, optical tests, strength tests and papermaking process testing.

alveoli.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology: Organs and Structures of the Respiratory System
alveoli.support: Alveolar walls are elastic; the thin type-I epithelium adjoins capillary endothelium to form the respiratory membrane. Bronchi are conducting structures rather than exchange surfaces.

cycles.title: NCERT Reproduction in Organisms, IIT Kanpur SATHEE hosted text
cycles.support: The textbook distinguishes menstrual cycles of monkeys/apes/humans from oestrous cycles of non-primate mammal examples such as cows, rats and tigers. This is the intended group comparison, not a universal claim about all primate species.

tissues.title: NCERT Tissues, IIT Kanpur SATHEE hosted text
tissues.support: Sclerenchyma is ordinarily dead at maturity with lignified walls and absent protoplast. Parenchyma, collenchyma and xylem parenchyma are living.

spermatogenesis.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology: Male Reproductive System
spermatogenesis.support: The primary spermatocyte undergoes meiosis I to generate secondary spermatocytes. The secondary spermatocytes undergo meiosis II; spermatogonia divide mitotically.

erythrocytes.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology: Erythrocytes
erythrocytes.support: Maturing erythrocytes shed the reticulum of ribosomes and lack nuclei and protein synthesis in their mature form. This is a concrete exception to Q95's universal wording, not permission to change its stem.

flowers.title: NCERT Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants, IIT Kanpur SATHEE hosted text
flowers.support: The nucellus enclosed by integuments has reserve food. Apple is a false fruit with a thalamus contribution; petals, sepals and stamens are not the relevant fleshy part.

respiration.title: NCERT Breathing and Exchange of Gases, IIT Kanpur SATHEE hosted text
respiration.support: Bronchi belong to the conducting part and alveoli to the exchange part. Typical adult tidal volume is about 500 mL, below residual, expiratory reserve and inspiratory reserve volumes.

pila.title: NCERT Breathing and Exchange of Gases: respiratory organs
pila.support: Earthworms exchange gases through moist skin; molluscs use gills and lungs depending on species. Pila has a ctenidium for aquatic exchange; human bronchi are the clearly non-respiratory-zone option.

heart.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology: Heart Anatomy
heart.support: The pulmonary semilunar valve guards the right ventricular outlet to the pulmonary trunk; the tricuspid valve guards the right atrioventricular opening, and mitral/bicuspid names the left atrioventricular valve.
